tests.title: Actual host
tests.expected: non-root uid; verified worktree/origin/one mutation owner; actual immediate resources and Rust toolchain recorded without secrets; Docker is NOT_USED unless a task actually invokes it.

tests.title: Recovery utility
tests.expected: start/checkpoint/finish/block/resume; bounded indices and orphan detection; forced interruption preserves dirty Git state and resumes without reset.

tests.title: Workspace
tests.expected: edition 2024/resolver3 workspace and dependency directions compile; Cargo.lock and exact toolchain checked in; direct dependency sources/features/licenses and unexpected build scripts reviewed.

tests.title: Quality
tests.expected: cargo fmt --all -- --check; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo test --workspace --locked; no ignored required tests.

tests.title: Standalone
tests.expected: cargo build --locked and cargo build; target/debug/oc --help; core app runs with PATH without node/bun/upstream, external MCP disabled.

tests.title: User forms
tests.expected: JSONC fragments assembled into valid config; native TOML separate; ludka static/ludka2 discovery; timeout:false and chunkTimeout preserved.

tests.title: Substitution/merge
tests.expected: baseline source-derived env/file escaping, precedence and permission merge; source/field diagnostics; original configs byte-unchanged.

tests.title: Capability failures
tests.expected: unknown npm, explicit codemode:true, OAuth:true or unsupported DCP mode give actionable errors; not silent acceptance.

tests.title: Trust/secrets/disabled
tests.expected: Location trust precedes substitutions/resource reads; lower-trust endpoint or command cannot use higher-trust credentials; untrusted/disabled candidates launch no network/process; selected-only credentials and explain/logs are redacted.

tests.title: Config roots
tests.expected: source-derived global/Location JSON/JSONC and .opencode order, canonical dedup and field provenance are deterministic; explicit config and separate cli.json behavior remain intact; inputs byte-unchanged.

tests.title: Instructions
tests.expected: global and applicable Location AGENTS sentinels enter provider instructions once in pinned order with provenance; unreadable/disappeared files are diagnosed and candidate generation retains no stale text.

tests.title: Definitions
tests.expected: singular/plural skill/agent/command roots, supported frontmatter and domain collisions are deterministic; invalid definition reports path/field/reason while valid siblings survive; selected/default invalid and subagent/reserved behavior fail explicitly.

tests.title: Native plugins
tests.expected: only exact bare/pinned DCP identities and admitted openproxy-models.js markers classify idempotently; unknown/lookalike/version/JS/TS sources fail before resolver/import/process/network and no plugin code executes.

tests.title: Vertical session
tests.expected: input→mock stream→persist→resume, identical application behavior local/headless.

tests.title: Lock/atomicity
tests.expected: second data root owner refused; owned no-follow root and restrictive permissions validated; state/event transactional and durable ack only after commit.

tests.title: Crash operations
tests.expected: kill after intent before/after side effect; recover unknown/partial, never autoreplay mutation.

tests.title: Blob/root failures
tests.expected: disk-full/read-only/blob-before-DB orphan behavior; unsafe custom data root and cleanup escape refused; no referenced blob deletion; quotas enforced.

tests.title: Cancel/shutdown
tests.expected: worker responsive during streaming; DB drained, terminal restored, own children reaped; no tasks retained per past session.

tests.title: Read/search
tests.expected: bounded file chunks, glob/grep stable sorted results, pagination, binary/large diagnostics; own data root rejected by direct path, recursion and symlink escape.

tests.title: Patch create
tests.expected: new/empty file, append to existing empty file, Unicode/CRLF/end newline; exact patch grammar fixtures.

tests.title: Patch edit/delete/move
tests.expected: targeted hunks/full text replacement/delete/move supported; no write/edit in model registry.

tests.title: Patch conflicts
tests.expected: Add existing, stale preimage, invalid later entry, protected/outside/data-root/symlink path; no success on partial; per-file result.

tests.title: Shell output/environment
tests.expected: interleaved stdout/stderr >caps; no deadlock/unbounded accumulation; correct exit/truncation; documented child env excludes provider/MCP/runner credentials.

tests.title: Shell cancel
tests.expected: timeout/TERM-resistant child/grandchild; KILL/wait/reap; elapsed bound; unknown versus cancelled outcomes.

tests.title: Web text
tests.expected: GET text/HTML/JSON, status/content type/original URL, bounded readable output and redirects.

tests.title: Web safety
tests.expected: private/link-local/loopback, DNS rebinding, IPv6 mapped address, redirect-to-private, large body, deadline; auth not inherited.

tests.title: Permissions
tests.expected: same runtime permission path for built-ins, MCP and compress; ask headless fails; invalid/untrusted config never allows; patch legacy deny wins.

tests.title: Tool graph
tests.expected: unknown tool/invalid JSON/duplicate call IDs/replayed done event do not execute; results match original call IDs.

tests.title: Skill loading
tests.expected: model sees bounded id/name/description without bodies; skill uses central permission and pinned bounded generation snapshot; unknown/removed/oversized/unreadable/stale calls fail visibly with a valid durable tool graph.

tests.title: Basic dynamic
tests.expected: unknown/new model IDs including slash, source suffix once, name formatting; no code changes/model list fallback.

tests.title: Metadata
tests.expected: JS safe integer/null-object/booleans/modalities validation; one invalid row leaves whole old catalog unchanged.

tests.title: Authority
tests.expected: ignore remote URL/npm/auth/options fields; credentials remain original; redirect:error.

tests.title: Merge
tests.expected: original local snapshot only; shallow nested limit/variants; explicit local override wins; local-only IDs removed on success.

tests.title: Limits
tests.expected: discovery context/input capped 500000; output unchanged; missing context/output removes limit; static ludka 628000 unaffected.

tests.title: Variants
tests.expected: remote allowlist disables missing standard names; custom names/effort retained; disabled hidden; local explicit override works.

tests.title: Timing
tests.expected: fake clock: each attempt ≤15000ms, total ≤30000ms incl body, ≤4 attempts and clipped 250/750/1500 delays; cancellation cleanup.

tests.title: Retry classes
tests.expected: 408/425/429/5xx/network/invalid JSON/empty retry; auth/bad shape/invalid row terminal; no retry layer multiplication.

tests.title: Publication
tests.expected: empty cold list never clears configured models; success removes retired IDs; duplicate ID last wins; bounded size failures atomic.

tests.title: Isolation
tests.expected: disabled provider no fetch; two provider/config generations independent; failed refresh never turns remote data into local overrides.

tests.title: Request
tests.expected: exact base prefix+/responses, Bearer, store:false, input/tool schemas and stable prompt_cache_key; no OAuth or API fallback.

tests.title: SSE/usage
tests.expected: arbitrary byte split, multiline/CRLF/comments/UTF8, text/item/argument stream and response usage metadata parsed incrementally; event cap enforced.

tests.title: Tool roundtrip
tests.expected: complete arguments→native tool→function_call_output→next response; multi-call order and ID validity.

tests.title: Reasoning
tests.expected: opaque/reasoning items persisted/replayed at correct boundary; model/provider switch does not reuse alien state; no opaque UI logging.

tests.title: Images
tests.expected: advertised text/image accepts bounded verified attachment; encoded request cap, unsupported audio/video/pdf visible.

tests.title: Errors
tests.expected: 401/403/429/5xx, incomplete/EOF, failure after delta; one retry owner, never repeat committed generation/tool.

tests.title: Timeouts
tests.expected: timeout:false no total deadline; chunkTimeout 6000000 not 6000; explicit cancel still closes request; connect separately bounded.

tests.title: Live wire
tests.expected: explicit opt-in real proxy published-model text+tool roundtrip through offline-tested harness; exact deployment/model/variant, request/input/output/time counters and watchdog/cancel outcome recorded; no all-model parity inference.

tests.title: Projection
tests.expected: raw history checksum stable; durable compression/prune changes only outbound context; no second history copy and no config/provider credentials enter projection.

tests.title: Range schema
tests.expected: topic/content/startId/endId/summary; stable IDs survive persistence/restart; invalid/stale/cross-session IDs and unfinished groups rejected.

tests.title: Nested/protected
tests.expected: upstream-derived overlapping/nested summaries, cycle/size checks; complete tool-call/result groups and protected file/tag/user bytes preserved.

tests.title: Patch protection
tests.expected: all affected paths parsed from patch; apply_patch treated as protected mutation equivalent; large protected content visible failure not loss.

tests.title: Nudges
tests.expected: threshold/percent/per-model, summary buffer, frequency/iteration/turn reset; no accumulating prompt-message copies.

tests.title: Prune timing
tests.expected: dedup and error input purge recalc at compression; latest required output and error text retained; protected/manual policy tested.

tests.title: Config/control
tests.expected: DCP precedence/read-only files, range permission and manual mode, notifications/stats; unsupported experimental options explicit.

tests.title: Recovery
tests.expected: cancel/stale generation/transaction failure cannot half-apply projection; restart reproduces stable IDs, same effective context and continuation without credential disclosure.

tests.title: Effectiveness
tests.expected: synthetic large closed span yields smaller outbound serialized context, required facts retained; no-gain compression bounded, not loop.

tests.title: Remote JSON
tests.expected: exact configured URL and 2025-11-25 initialize/headers, bearer, POST/JSON, no session ID/GET dependency; no URL probing/rewrite; observed OpenProxy shape supported.

tests.title: Remote lifecycle
tests.expected: JSON/SSE adapter paths, 405 optional GET, auth/timeout/invalid replies, cancellation and list update; no reconnect storm.

tests.title: Registry
tests.expected: namespaced collision-safe names map exact server/tool, paginated bounded schema/catalog, isError surfaced.

tests.title: Stdio
tests.expected: fake child JSON-RPC stdout + bounded stderr, kill/reap, restart config generation, no cross-auth/cwd sharing; child env excludes provider/MCP/runner credentials.

tests.title: Disabled browser
tests.expected: exact npx argv preserved; enabled:false zero process/browser probe and no Node requirement; true explicitly selected fake/real smoke.

tests.title: Live search
tests.expected: explicit opt-in real codex_web search returns non-fabricated result; actual errors propagate; no auto OAuth/unknown-effect retry; search/time counters and watchdog outcome recorded.

tests.title: PTY qualification
tests.expected: input/paste/Unicode/resize, stream/Ctrl-C and terminal restoration on error/panic/exit under local and SSH-like PTY conditions.

tests.title: Model picker
tests.expected: dynamic catalog/variants/refresh status, user choice persisted, retired model actionable, no automatic silent fallback.

tests.title: History/diff
tests.expected: pagination/session switch/resume/tool cards/diff without whole-history rendering/backing-store growth.

tests.title: DCP panel
tests.expected: context/stats/manual controls, /dcp-compress focus becomes bounded instruction, notification not duplicate history.

tests.title: Headless JSON
tests.expected: NDJSON only stdout; errors stderr; bounded slow consumer; interrupted exit code non-success.

tests.title: Workspace definitions
tests.expected: primary-agent selection, slash completion/invocation, skill catalog/tool card, redacted provenance/diagnostic and Location switch use one current-generation registry; stale actions fail and old local entries disappear.

tests.title: Offline coding
tests.expected: scripted provider fixes seeded Rust bug through read/apply_patch/bash; fixture tests pass; no edits outside fixture.

tests.title: Live coding
tests.expected: explicit opt-in published model fixes the fixture with actual tools, no edits outside fixture, bounded campaign counters; reopened session and next command succeed; API/facts/tests verified without exact-text matching.

tests.title: Compress then resume
tests.expected: model calls compress then uses retained fact to patch/test; restart and next prompt succeed; output context reduced.

tests.title: Web workflow
tests.expected: webfetch tool and codex_web search preserve source info; browser smoke conditional on explicit opt-in, never claimed if not run.

tests.title: Configured workspace
tests.expected: offline scripted provider consumes global plus Location A instructions/agent/command/skill with skill body absent until call and both native aliases wired; switch to B retains global, removes A-local and uses no JS/Node/Bun/network.

tests.title: Soak
tests.expected: baseline-derived fixed synthetic workload over bounded active context exercises many sessions/switches, periodic compress/cancel/MCP errors and stable resource counters; workload is frozen before qualification.

tests.title: Output pressure
tests.expected: large shell/provider/tool outputs, slow UI scroll/paging, queue cap, blob quota and cancellation under load; no hidden second transcript.

tests.title: Measurements
tests.expected: baseline/peak/post-idle RSS/PSS plus task/process/queue/cache/DB/WAL metrics; allocator RSS alone not leak conclusion.

tests.title: Regression
tests.expected: fixed workload/seeds/toolchain/machine; adopt baseline-derived caps, compare no linear retained-history slope; clean shutdown checked.

tests.title: Provenance
tests.expected: DCP/OpenCode borrowed code/prompts/tests have pinned source/path/digest/license/notices and normalization recipe; no unsupported license claims for OpenProxy copied code.

tests.title: Secrets Git
tests.expected: final staged tracked content/fixtures/reports reviewed; no keys/URL credentials/raw payload/DB/.local; push normal own branch only.

tests.title: Goal handoff
tests.expected: A01–A13 independent allowed status with authoritative scenarios/evidence; exact commands/commit/live blockers, launch, supported differences and known limitations; READY only mandatory live passes, no full parity claim, delivery separate; missing live keeps T30 blocked.

tests.title: Fresh restart
tests.expected: new test HOME/XDG/data, built oc starts without upstream/Node, examples read-only, new sessions persist; no migration/release code.

tests.title: Agent-neutral execution
tests.expected: package checks and progress utility run without Codex executable, /goal, GPT/Luna configuration or a required agent tool API; generic objective is nonempty, active execution surfaces have no fixed runner identity, and OC_TEST_MODEL remains product-test-only.

tests.title: Executable sends a real configured request
tests.expected: Запустить target/debug/oc run как subprocess с временными HOME/XDG/project/data и local fake Responses. Endpoint получил запрос; выбранный model и env credentials использованы; ответ не echo. При отсутствии конфигурации nonzero diagnostic, не mock fallback.

tests.title: Same application for CLI/TUI and durable restart
tests.expected: Отдельные процессы CLI и PTY TUI используют один config/runtime contract. После закрытия и нового запуска с тем же data-root история восстанавливается и реально участвует в следующем запросе. Own storage не находится в tmp по умолчанию.

tests.title: Upstream-style Add File bytes
tests.expected: Patch Add File с +hello создаёт ровно hello\n, не +hello\n; empty Add, Unicode и Update пустого файла корректны; parser/schema одинаковы.

tests.title: Temporary symlink and path confinement
tests.expected: Предсозданный symlink на ожидаемом temporary path, symlink parent и замена parent между validation/commit не меняют outside sentinel. Add/move не затирают concurrent target. Нет следования существующему temp inode.

tests.title: Preflight and honest partial outcome
tests.expected: Ошибка hunk/preimage в позднем файле выявляется до записи ранних файлов. Отдельный inject I/O failure после разрешённого первого commit возвращает failure с точными committed paths/hashes, не success и не обещание rollback.

tests.title: Intent precedes mutation and survives process kill
tests.expected: Inject storage failure до intent исключает изменение файла/вызов MCP. Kill subprocess после side effect до outcome даёт durable started→unknown после reopen, без повторного исполнения.

tests.title: Mixed tool order and terminal transaction
tests.expected: Builtin/MCP/builtin исполняются в объявленном порядке. DB fault не скрывается. Accepted input и terminal message/event/turn не расходятся при restart.

tests.title: Existing orphan blob is repaired or rejected
tests.expected: Создать valid content-addressed файл без DB row, затем write_blob тех же bytes. Успешно возвращённый digest читается через read_blob; crash после rename и до row не создаёт ложного успеха; quota и GC не удаляют referenced blob.

tests.title: Strict function_call continuation
tests.expected: Fake выдаёт item_id=fc_A и call_id=call_B. Второй запрос обязан содержать function_call_output.call_id=call_B и replayable output items. Подмена обычным user text или item_id отвергается fake-сервером.

tests.title: Reasoning/images/restart wire integrity
tests.expected: Store:false два tool rounds и новый process сохраняют необходимые opaque items без их UI/log раскрытия. Input image реально присутствует в wire, либо выбранная неподдержанная modality получает explicit diagnostic; A04 не закрывается только helper test.

tests.title: Terminal and budget outcomes
tests.expected: Оборвать stream после корректного text event без completed; передать response.failed/incomplete; исчерпать max rounds. Ни один случай не Completed. Incomplete call не исполняется, уже совершённый результат не теряется/не повторяется.

tests.title: Cancellation and actual streaming
tests.expected: Fake посылает один chunk, затем молчит. Cancel завершает turn за тестовый bound, не ожидая chunkTimeout. Отмена работает и до headers. Первый delta виден процессу/PTY до terminal event.

tests.title: Bounds and effective options
tests.expected: Длинная незавершённая SSE line, oversized args/event/request ограничены по bytes без пропорционального роста. Custom chunkTimeout, max_output_tokens, headers и setCacheKey проверяются по captured request/clock. 400 не auto-retry.

tests.title: Global/project configured workspace through binary
tests.expected: Запустить oc в A и B с общими global и разными project configs/AGENTS/skills/agents/commands. Captured request доказывает правильный порядок, один экземпляр инструкции, отсутствие A-local content в B и запрет cross-Location session.

tests.title: Agent prompt and literal commands
tests.expected: Два primary profiles с одинаковой description, но разными body дают разные snapshots и requests. Command с `cargo test` и code fence загружается буквально, не исполняется loader; аргумент с $2 не переинтерполируется.

tests.title: Legacy deny and untrusted configuration
tests.expected: permissions apply_patch=allow плюс legacy write/edit=deny не разрешают patch. Аналогичная agent-specific narrowing применяется. Unknown dangerous fields и untrusted substitutions дают diagnostics до side effect; исходный config unchanged.

tests.title: Native plugins and skill snapshot
tests.expected: Known bound DCP/discovery marker активирует ровно один compiled module без JS. Unknown plugin диагностируется; модельный skill возвращает pinned body, не новый reread. Missing/malformed/oversized definitions не становятся silent defaults.

tests.title: Discovery oracle edge cases
tests.expected: Сравнить Rust и locked user oracle: 2^53 rejected, multi-slash IDs/display names, conflicting header spellings, missing credentials, empty/retryable envelopes, removed IDs, static ludka limits not clamped. Нет remote override URL/options/SDK.

tests.title: Compress/glob/grep are actually exposed
tests.expected: Captured real binary request содержит admitted compress/glob/grep schemas. Fake вызывает compress с валидными anchors; общий dispatcher выполняет его и отдаёт structured output.

tests.title: Nudges and automatic strategies reach the model
tests.expected: В captured request видны своевременные nudges; после model compress соблюдаются cooldown/manual rules, dedup и purgeErrors меняют только заявленные части, error messages сохранены. Counters из другой сессии не влияют.

tests.title: Compression is durable and accurately reported
tests.expected: Crash во время multi-range change не даёт половину projection. No-gain не считается сэкономленными tokens всей истории. Protected/nested facts и raw transcript сохраняются; после process restart следующий request корректен.

tests.title: User MCP config works unmodified
tests.expected: Собрать McpEntry из JSONC с headers.Authorization; initialize/list/call проходит strict fake. lowercase/mixed-case эквивалентны, conflicts диагностируются. Не делать OAuth/probing URL.

tests.title: Generation-owned lifetime and shutdown
tests.expected: Два turns одной generation создают один MCP child/handshake. Reload/disable/restart меняют ровно нужные ресурсы. Crash/failure/cancel cleanup не оставляет owned wrapper/descendants; disabled chrome zero-spawn.

tests.title: Registry and result semantics
tests.expected: Collision-prone names направляют вызов в правильный original server/tool. Oversized catalog видим. Неподдержанная modality и isError не success. Search request соответствует server schema, а не helper limit argument.

tests.title: Unicode HTML and standard URL handling
tests.expected:
html_to_text("

Привет 🦀

") не panic и сохраняет текст. Проверить entity handling, malformed HTML, relative redirects, query-only URLs и IPv6; никаких lossy byte-as-char преобразований.

tests.title: Dial-bound egress and total deadline
tests.expected: Контролируемый resolver меняет public→loopback/private между lookup и connect: запрещённый destination не получает HTTP request. Redirect не обходит policy; headers не текут. Deadline общий на все hops.

tests.title: Stdin/output deadlock and orphaned pipe
tests.expected: В отдельном subprocess под outer watchdog: child не читает большой stdin; child сначала пишет большие stdout/stderr; leader выходит, descendant держит pipe/игнорирует TERM. Timeout/cancel завершается в bound и owned descendants убраны.

tests.title: Working toolchain with minimal environment
tests.expected: Обычные fixture cargo/rustc commands работают в production tool path без абсолютных подсказок, добавленных только тестом. Provider/MCP/runner credentials не наследуются; symlink cwd escape отклонён.

tests.title: Actual PTY panels and workspace operations
tests.expected: PTY запускает target binary и клавишами выбирает model/variant/agent/session, открывает skills, dispatches custom command и DCP. Request/runtime state реально меняется; screenshot/render helper отдельно недостаточен.

tests.title: Paste/cancel/resize/error terminal recovery
tests.expected: Bracketed paste, Cyrillic/emoji, resize во время stream, Ctrl-C и ошибочный output handle завершаются корректно. Тест подтверждает terminal flags/restoration и отсутствие лишних persisted user messages.

tests.title: Paged UI backing state
tests.expected: Длинная история и переходы между многими sessions не увеличивают UI retained bytes пропорционально архиву; старые страницы выгружаются, нужные tool cards не ограничены первыми 200 старейшими записями.

tests.title: Equal active context, growing archive
tests.expected: Synthetic binary workload с малым и большим архивом при одинаковой активной projection показывает bounded retained state/peak construction, без полного чтения history. Размеры workload фиксируются до прогона; отчёт содержит фактические значения.

tests.title: No silent history truncation
tests.expected: Payload >64KiB, но внутри configured model/input budgets, обрабатывается в заявленном режиме, а не молча теряет старые факты. Oversized current input/prior также ограничен; data loss не маскируется под DCP.

tests.title: Output retention versus model preview
tests.expected: Нужный факт после первых 2048 bytes tool output остаётся доступен в разрешённом result/blob/read continuation. UI preview bounded, raw output не размножается в нескольких lifetime-long buffers.

tests.title: One binary golden workflow
tests.expected: Executable fake campaign проходит A01–A13 paths: effective config → Responses/tool loop → file/tests → MCP → model compress → process restart → workspace switch. Outbound/side effects/terminal states проверяются независимо.

tests.title: Evidence cannot pass by skipping required work
tests.expected: Explicit mandatory harness при missing creds/MCP emits BLOCKED/non-success. Aggregate не преобразует ignored/skip/early return в PASS. Unexecuted cases и их причины присутствуют в JSON/report.

tests.title: Bounded live harness ready before paid run
tests.expected: Live campaign использует product binary/config/catalog, existing counters/watchdog/budget, exact chosen model/variant; compulsory MCP не optional skip. Все harness branches предварительно испытаны offline, без покупки live retries.

tests.title: Clean build and regression qualification
tests.expected: На одном зафиксированном commit проходят actual cargo fmt/clippy/test/build --locked, mandatory audit regressions, binary no-required-Node scenario и static architecture/secret/provenance checks. Команды/версии/выходы приложены.

tests.title: All findings mapped to current evidence
tests.expected: F01–F18 имеют ссылку на исправляющий commit/test/report или честный unresolved blocker. Старый T24/T25/T28/T29 PASS не используется вместо нового binary evidence. Нет unsupported→supported без теста.

tests.title: Final readiness depends on actual gates
tests.expected: T30 FINAL перечисляет A01–A13 и обязательные live outcomes T27. READY невозможен при любом unresolved P0/P1 или missing mandatory live gate; offline-qualified external block не маскирует product gap.

tests.title: Unknown model limits and explicit variants
tests.expected: Actual runtime и binary используют configured native fallback budgets при missing/partial/zero model limits; warning видим, metadata остаётся unknown, DISC05 unchanged. Input/output budgets соблюдаются до каждого HTTP request, включая child/title. Без explicit variant reasoning overlay не выбирается; explicit enabled variant сохраняется.

tests.title: Resource permissions retain authority
tests.expected: Ordered action/resource maps проверяют каждый реальный resource (включая patch rename); unmatched resource не получает allow, ask не dispatches. Central/primary/child constraints только сужают authority, включая selected/restored primary. Hidden/disabled и denied agents не появляются в автоматическом каталоге; literal wildcard в resource не обходит deny.

tests.title: MCP degradation and safe projection parity
tests.expected: D13: один failed attach/relist не отменяет turn, warning видим, initial failed server tools отсутствуют, failed relist сохраняет старый catalog; fatal cancel/cleanup/caps и reaping сохранены. UA отправляется. Structured/text/resource-link results и bounded initialize instructions доходят до provider только в допустимой projection, не меняют history и не раскрывают secrets; denied/ask/failed servers не дают guidance, errors остаются failed с safe category. Media outputs не выдаются за успешный partial result.
